senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (-झषति)
To kill or hurt.
2 To take.
3 To put on, to wear.

m. (-षः)
1 A fish.
2 The sign Pisces.
3 Heat, warmth.
4 A forest, a thicket.
f. (-षा)
A plant, (Hedysarum lagopodioides.)
n. (-षं)
Waste land.
E.
झष to injure, affix अच्.

m. (-नः)
A name of KANDARPA.
E.
झष a fish, and केतन a banner, who bears a fish on his banner.

m. (-ङ्कः)
A name of ANIRUDDHA, the son of KĀMA.
E.
झष a fish, and अङ्क a mark or symbol.

m. (-नः)
The gangetic porpoise.
E.
झष fish, and अशन food.

f. (-री)
A proper name, the mother of the poet VYĀSA.
E.
झष a fish, and उदर the belly: born from the belly of a fish.
